■ Enforcement Decree of the Korea Tourism Organization Act [Attached Table] <Newly Inserted on May 8, 2018>

Standards for Imposition of Administrative Fines (Related to Article 12)

1. General Standards
(a) The increased standards for imposing administrative fines based on the number of violations shall apply where an administrative fine has been imposed for the same violation within the preceding one year. The period shall be calculated based on the date on which the administrative fine was imposed for the prior violation and the date on which the same violation is subsequently detected.
(b) Where an increased disposition is imposed under item (a), the applicable number of violations shall be the number immediately following the number of the prior disposition; where two or more administrative-fine dispositions were imposed during the period under item (a), the higher number shall apply.
(c) The imposing authority may reduce the amount of an administrative fine by up to one-half of the amount prescribed in the individual standards under subparagraph 2, taking into account the motive, details, and consequences of the violation.

2. Individual Standards
Violation | Legal Basis | Amount of Administrative Fine (10,000 won)
(a) Where a person other than the Organization uses the name "Korea Tourism Organization" in violation of Article 6 of the Act | Article 19 (1) of the Act | First violation: 100 / Second violation: 200 / Third or subsequent violation: 300
(b) Where a person other than the Organization uses a name similar to "Korea Tourism Organization" in violation of Article 6 of the Act | Article 19 (1) of the Act | First violation: 50 / Second violation: 100 / Third or subsequent violation: 200
